## Actual test
Convert donor texture to vertex colors; weld vertices rounded to six decimals; sparse normalized edge adjacency. Let sigmoid be logistic. Body mask sigmoid((.18-y)/.055)*sigmoid((y+.37)/.045), back mask sigmoid((.15-z)/.08), flank=body*(.55+.45*back). Smooth vertices 24 or 55 iterations with step .43*flank; move rear z forward by .24 or .39 times body*back*max(0,.12-z), widen x by 9%*body and lift y .035*body*back. Blend donor body color toward cream (.83,.75,.64), project original crop on face with local mask (u=267+390*x, v=145-440*(y-.245)). First two renderings showed obvious cracks. Second actual iteration uses KD-tree union of vertex pairs within .0015 model units, averaged positions and colors, removes duplicate and degenerate faces and fills small holes; repeats stronger deformation. Exported actual native GLBs, then reimported each and rendered 0/45/90/135/180 degrees via VTK offscreen.
